description: §5.2.4 NEG mirror of `s450-attr-multi-statement-pos` — a `;` inside a nested arrow body or a string literal of a single-expression NON-handler value, and a `;`-separated inline block on an EVENT HANDLER, do not fire E-ATTR-MULTI-STATEMENT.
rationale: §5.2.4 (S450): a `;` is a separator only between statements of the value itself — "a `;` inside a string, template, regex or comment, inside a nested arrow / function body, or in the text of a markup value is not a separator" — and "an event-handler attribute (§5.2.3) is not judged by this rule". The `title=` value is ONE expression (an IIFE call) and `onclick={ … }` is the §5.2.3 inline block, so the code SHALL stay silent.
